description: This file defines a REST API resource class 'ProvisioningEntriesApiResource' for managing provisioning entries related to loan products in the Apache Fineract project. It includes endpoints for creating, modifying, retrieving, and listing provisioning entries, with integration to security, command execution, and data serialization services.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for provisioning entry operations in the Fineract accounting provisioning module.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create new provisioning entries using provided request data.

methods.name: modifyProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Handles POST requests to modify or recreate provisioning entries based on entry ID and command parameter.

methods.name: retrieveProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch details of a specific provisioning entry by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveProviioningEntries
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list provisioning entries with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all provisioning entries with pagination support.

methods.name: getResultByCommandParam
methods.description: Utility method to process command type and generate corresponding command execution results.
